data.narrative:
Enovix is a public-stage Climate & Energy company currently valued at $1.0B, having raised $700M+ since inception. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of three same-sector, same-stage comparables: QuantumScape ($3.6B), Solid Power ($504M), and LanzaTech ($73M). A broader opportunity set includes eight additional private frontier-tech peers in energy storage and advanced materials.

The peer-median method, the primary applicable triangulation approach given limited public comparable depth, yields an implied valuation of $504M based on the median of the three-company sample. This method spans a wide range—from $73M at the low end (LanzaTech) to $3.6B at the high end (QuantumScape)—reflecting substantial heterogeneity in stage maturity and commercialization progress within the cohort. No revenue or margin multiples could be applied due to limited profitability data across the peer set.

The triangulated range derived from available methods supports a valuation between $428M and $580M, with a median of $504M. Enovix's current $1.0B valuation sits approximately 98% above the peer median, suggesting either a material premium or potential overvaluation relative to public comparables. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of a three-company peer set, heterogeneous technology risk profiles across comparables, and the impact of capital intensity and commercialization timelines on investor expectations in frontier energy technology.
